topics.label: Introduction and Overview of the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture objectives and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Factor Independence and Evasion of Growth Suppression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the signaling cascades and genetic mutations that allow cancer cells to sustain proliferation and ignore growth inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells halt terminal differentiation across hematologic and solid tissue malignancies.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and downstream apoptotic regulators.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit via telomerase reactivation while evading senescence and normal stress-response checkpoints.

topics.label: Deregulating Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolic pathways and generate oncometabolites to sustain growth.

topics.label: Inducing Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the angiogenic switch and vascular development required to sustain expanding tumor masses.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological steps, systemic dissemination, microenvironmental determinants, and clonal genetics of cancer metastasis.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: These concluding remarks summarize the core themes of the lecture and provide closing housekeeping details.
